name: line-chart
title: Line Chart
author: Almas Kasymzhanov <almaskasymzhanov@gmail.com>
description: Multi-series lines for continuous time-series — change over time, indexed comparisons, forecasts. The FT / John Burn-Murdoch canon: direct line-end labels instead of a legend, one emphasized series in the accent while the rest mute to grey (never a rainbow), faint horizontal gridlines (the deliberate deviation from the no-gridline bar rule), honest gaps where data is missing (y: null breaks the line, never interpolated), a Y domain that reads change not magnitude-from-zero, and editorial layers (event markers, recession-shading bands, dashed forecast lines). Monospace numerics (Hack), built-in source attribution, reference line (fixed or mean/median), crosshair multi-series tooltip, native PNG/SVG/CSV export, JSON portability. Zero dependencies beyond React. Built to WCAG 2.2 AA: roving tabindex, ARIA graphics roles, screen-reader data table, forced-colors support.
